messages:
anika: Evening — can someone run a quick perf sample against canary v2.3? CI alerted that p95 is up ~90ms vs main. Need concrete numbers before we decide hold/rollback. cc @tomas @sara

tomas: on it. what's the workload shape? short vs long sequences, and how many samples?

anika: short seq (64), steady-state. aim for n=1000. run this local shim if helpful:
```
./scripts/run_perf.sh --canary v2.3 --baseline main --seed 42 --n 1000 --seq 64
```
Also compare fastpath vs fallback.

tomas: kicking off perf-ci job now (will post link).

perf-ci: perf job queued: #5021 — running samples against canary v2.3 and baseline main. see https://perf.ci/jobs/5021

deploy-bot: Canary v2.3 deployment status: 12/20 shards healthy, autoscaler engaged. rolling window open.

perf-ci: Job #5021 finished: baseline p95=130ms, canary p95=215ms (+65%). p50 baseline=45ms, canary p50=47ms. throughput stable. full artifacts: https://perf.ci/artifacts/5021/results.csv

sara: :eyes: that's well above our p95 delta threshold (20%). I recommend we pause the rollout and start triage. @jun (ops-oncall) any objection?

jun: Pausing rollout now and shifting traffic back to baseline variant. Holding further rollouts until triage finishes. Can someone attach profiles and a request sample set?

tomas: uploading profiles -> s3://redwood-perf/profiles/5021/profile-5021.tar.gz. Also opened bisect ticket RWK-867. Next step: kernel traces + flamegraphs. Quick note — I saw a config drift in the canary image earlier: the mix-quant flag got toggled to true in the bake. worth checking first.

anika: thanks. if quant flag is the culprit we can flip back and re-run a miniature sample.

jun: noted. tagging infra on the bisect ticket. If anyone spots hot kernels or unexpected memcpy spikes, paste logs here.

tomas: will post kernel traces in ~20m. For now I've pinned the perf run artifacts and a small sample of requests in the ticket.

anika: great — thanks all. hold on major roll decisions until tomas posts traces. :thumbsup:
